Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: The _____ was Emperor of Cao Wei of China (220 - 226).
Cao Pi.fact: Cao Pi () (c.late 187 – 29 June 226), courtesy name Zihuan, was the first emperor of the state of Cao Wei in the Three Kingdoms period of China.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: He was the second son of Cao Cao, a warlord who lived in the late _____ dynasty, but the eldest son among all the children born to Cao Cao by his concubine (later wife), Lady Bian
Cao Pi.fact: He was the second son of Cao Cao, a warlord who lived in the late Eastern Han dynasty, but the eldest son among all the children born to Cao Cao by his concubine (later wife), Lady Bian.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: After the defeat of Cao Cao's rival _____ at the Battle of Guandu, he took Yuan Xi's wife, Lady Zhen, as a concubine, but in 221 Lady Zhen died and Guo Nüwang became empress
Cao Pi.fact: After the defeat of Cao Cao's rival Yuan Shao at the Battle of Guandu, he took Yuan Xi's wife, Lady Zhen, as a concubine, but in 221 Lady Zhen died and Guo Nüwang became empress.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: During his reign, he formally established _____'s nine-rank system as the base for civil service nomination, which drew many talents into his government
Cao Pi.fact: During his reign, he formally set up Chen Qun's nine-rank system as the base for civil service nomination, which drew many talents into his government.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: He wrote _____ (燕歌行), the first Chinese poem in the style of seven syllables per line (七言詩)
Cao Pi.fact: He wrote Yan Ge Xing (燕歌行), the first Chinese poem in the style of seven syllables per line (七言詩).

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: After Cao Cao defeated _____ then conquered the city of Ye and massacred his population
Cao Pi.fact: After Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shang then conquered the city of Ye and massacred his population.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: This position placed him second to his father, who was then _____ (丞相) and the de facto head of government in China
Cao Pi.fact: This position placed him second to his father, who was then Imperial Chancellor (丞相) and the de facto head of government in China.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: Cao Cao greatly favoured _____ (his third son with Lady Bian), who was known for his literary talents
Cao Pi.fact: Cao Cao greatly favoured Cao Zhi (his third son with Lady Bian), who was known for his literary talents. Both Cao Pi and Cao Zhi were talented poets, but Cao Zhi was more highly regarded as a poet and speaker.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: Cui Yan was executed, while _____ was deposed
Cao Pi.fact: Initially, Cao Zhi's party appeared to be prevailing, and in 216 they were successful in falsely accusing two officials supporting Cao Pi—Cui Yan and Mao Jie. Cui Yan was executed, while Mao Jie was deposed.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: The apprehension was particularly heightened when, after Cao Cao's death, the _____ under the general Zang Ba suddenly deserted, leaving Luoyang and returning home
Cao Pi.fact: The apprehension was particularly heightened when, after Cao Cao's death, the Qingzhou Corps under the general Zang Ba suddenly deserted, leaving Luoyang and returning home.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: With the help of _____, the political situation soon stabilised
Cao Pi.fact: With the help of Jiang Ji, the political situation soon stabilised.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: This event marked the official end of the Han dynasty and the beginning of the _____ period
Cao Pi.fact: This event marked the official end of the Han dynasty and the beginning of the Three Kingdoms period.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: The dethroned _____ was granted the title "Duke of Shanyang" (山陽公)
Cao Pi.fact: Emperor Xian did so, and Cao Pi formally declined three times (a model that would be followed by future usurpers in Chinese history), and then finally accepted on 25 November of that year, establishing the state of Cao Wei. The dethroned Emperor Xian was granted the title "Duke of Shanyang" (山陽公).

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: He also moved the imperial capital from _____ to Luoyang
Cao Pi.fact: He also moved the imperial capital from Xuchang to Luoyang.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: Sun Quan, who controlled the vast majority of southeastern and southern _____, did not take any affirmative steps one way or another, leaving his options open
Cao Pi.fact: Sun Quan, who controlled the vast majority of southeastern and southern China, did not take any affirmative steps one way or another, leaving his options open.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: Cao Pi () (c.late _____ – 29 June 226), courtesy name Zihuan, was the first emperor of the state of Cao Wei in the Three Kingdoms period of China
Cao Pi.fact: Cao Pi () (c.late 187 – 29 June 226), courtesy name Zihuan, was the first emperor of the state of Cao Wei in the Three Kingdoms period of China.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: By this time, having defeated Shu, the Wu forces enjoyed high morale and effective leadership from _____, Lu Xun and a number of other capable generals
Cao Pi.fact: After Sun Quan's forces, under the command of Lu Xun, defeated Shu forces at the Battle of Xiaoting in 222, Sun Quan began to distance himself from Wei. When Cao Pi demanded that Sun Quan send his heir apparent, Sun Deng, to Luoyang as a hostage, Sun Quan refused and formally broke ties with Wei.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: The division of the former _____ into three states has become firmly established, particularly after Liu Bei's death in 223
Cao Pi.fact: The division of the former Han Empire into three states has become firmly established, particularly after Liu Bei's death in 223.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: Ding Yi, who was chief among _____'s strategists, had his whole clan exterminated as a result of assisting the latter in the past
Cao Pi.fact: Ding Yi, who was chief among Cao Zhi's strategists, had his whole clan exterminated as a result of assisting the latter in the past.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: For example, _____ was captured by Liu Bei's general Guan Yu at the Battle of Fancheng in 219, and was later taken back to Wu and detained there after the Wu invasion of Jing Province
Cao Pi.fact: For example, Yu Jin was captured by Liu Bei's general Guan Yu at the Battle of Fancheng in 219, and was later taken back to Wu and detained there after the Wu invasion of Jing Province. Yu Jin was allowed to return to Wei after Wu briefly became a vassal state under Wei in 221.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: However, before _____'s departure, he was instructed to travel to Ye to pay his respects at Cao Cao's tomb
Cao Pi.fact: For example, Yu Jin was captured by Liu Bei's general Guan Yu at the Battle of Fancheng in 219, and was later taken back to Wu and detained there after the Wu invasion of Jing Province. Yu Jin was allowed to return to Wei after Wu briefly became a vassal state under Wei in 221.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: When Yu Jin arrived, he found that the emperor had commissioned artists to paint, in his father's tomb, scenes of the Battle of _____
Cao Pi.fact: When Yu Jin arrived, he found that the emperor had commissioned artists to paint, in his father's tomb, scenes of the Battle of Fancheng.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: Upon seeing the vivid mural, _____ was so filled with regret and shame that he fell ill and soon died
Cao Pi.fact: However, before Yu Jin's departure, he was instructed to travel to Ye to pay his respects at Cao Cao's tomb. When Yu Jin arrived, he found that the emperor had commissioned artists to paint, in his father's tomb, scenes of the Battle of Fancheng.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: In August 221, _____ died and the position of empress went to Guo Nüwang
Cao Pi.fact: Lady Zhen was his wife. In August 221, Lady Zhen died and the position of empress went to Guo Nüwang.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: Instead, _____ was appointed "Prince of Pingyuan" after his father's ascension to the throne
Cao Pi.fact: Cao Rui was the eldest of Cao Pi's sons, but because of his mother's death, he was not instated as the crown prince. Instead, Cao Rui was appointed "Prince of Pingyuan" after his father's ascension to the throne.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: On his deathbed, he entrusted _____ to the care of Cao Zhen, Chen Qun and Sima Yi
Cao Pi.fact: Instead, Cao Rui was appointed "Prince of Pingyuan" after his father's ascension to the throne. (It might have been because the other sons were all significantly younger, although their ages were not recorded in history.) In the summer of 226, when Cao Pi was seriously ill, he finally named Cao Rui as his crown prince.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: Following his father's death, _____ ascended the throne at the age of 21
Cao Pi.fact: (It might have been because the other sons were all significantly younger, although their ages were not recorded in history.) In the summer of 226, when Cao Pi was seriously ill, he finally named Cao Rui as his crown prince. On his deathbed, he entrusted Cao Rui to the care of Cao Zhen, Chen Qun and Sima Yi.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: 235) Shuyuan, of the Pan clan (淑媛 潘氏) _____, Prince Wen'an (文安王 曹蕤; d
Cao Pi.fact: (It might have been because the other sons were all significantly younger, although their ages were not recorded in history.) In the summer of 226, when Cao Pi was seriously ill, he finally named Cao Rui as his crown prince. On his deathbed, he entrusted Cao Rui to the care of Cao Zhen, Chen Qun and Sima Yi.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: 233), 3rd son Shuyuan, of the Zhu clan (淑媛 朱氏) _____, Prince Huai of Dongwuyang (東武陽懷王 曹鑑; d
Cao Pi.fact: 233), 3rd son Shuyuan, of the Zhu clan (淑媛 朱氏) Cao Jian, Prince Huai of Dongwuyang (東武陽懷王 曹鑑; d.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: 225/226) Zhaoyi, of the Qiu clan (昭儀 仇氏) _____, Prince Ding of Donghai (東海定王 曹霖; d
Cao Pi.fact: 225/226) Zhaoyi, of the Qiu clan (昭儀 仇氏) Cao Lin, Prince Ding of Donghai (東海定王 曹霖; d.

Cao Pi.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Pi.question: 223) Lady, of the Song clan (宋氏) _____, Prince Ai of Guangping (廣平哀王 曹儼; d
Cao Pi.fact: 223) Lady, of the Song clan (宋氏) Cao Yan, Prince Ai of Guangping (廣平哀王 曹儼; d.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: The _____ was Chinese Han dynasty and Cao Wei general (168–223).
Cao Ren.fact: Cao Ren () (168 – 6 May 223), courtesy name Zixiao, was a military general serving during the late Eastern Han dynasty of China under the warlord Cao Cao, who was also his older second cousin.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: He continued serving in the state of _____ – founded by Cao Cao's son and successor, Cao Pi – during the Three Kingdoms period
Cao Ren.fact: He continued serving in the state of Cao Wei – set up by Cao Cao's son and successor, Cao Pi – during the Three Kingdoms period.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: He was appointed as the _____ (大司馬) when Cao Pi ascended the throne, and was also credited by the latter for the establishment of Wei
Cao Ren.fact: He was appointed as the Grand Marshal (大司馬) when Cao Pi ascended the throne, and was also credited by the latter for the establishment of Wei.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: His grandfather _____ (曹襃) and father Cao Chi (曹熾) served in the government of the Eastern Han dynasty
Cao Ren.fact: His grandfather Cao Bao (曹襃) and father Cao Chi (曹熾) served in the government of the Eastern Han dynasty.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: He had a younger full brother, _____
Cao Ren.fact: He had a younger full brother, Cao Chun. As their father died when they were still young, Cao Ren and Cao Chun lived with another family.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: He made great contributions in the campaign against _____ between 197 and 199
Cao Ren.fact: He made great contributions in the campaign against Yuan Shu between 197 and 199.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: After Cao Cao had defeated the _____ rebels, he received Emperor Xian (who had escaped from the clutches of Li Jue and Guo Si) and set up the new capital at Xu (許; present-day Xuchang, Henan) in 196
Cao Ren.fact: After Cao Cao had defeated the Yellow Turban rebels, he received Emperor Xian (who had escaped from the clutches of Li Jue and Guo Si) and set up the new capital at Xu (許; present-day Xuchang, Henan) in 196.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: Zhang Xiu surrendered to Cao Cao initially, but rebelled later and launched a surprise attack, which led to the Battle of _____
Cao Ren.fact: The following year, Cao Ren followed Cao Cao on a campaign against the warlord Zhang Xiu, and was authorised to lead a separate force to raid the counties around Zhang Xiu's base in Wan (宛; or Wancheng, present-day Wancheng District, Nanyang, Henan) and he captured over 3,000 civilians. Zhang Xiu surrendered to Cao Cao initially, but rebelled later and launched a surprise attack, which led to the Battle of Wancheng.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: Cao Cao was defeated and he retreated after his forces succeeded in repelling further attacks by _____
Cao Ren.fact: The following year, Cao Ren followed Cao Cao on a campaign against the warlord Zhang Xiu, and was authorised to lead a separate force to raid the counties around Zhang Xiu's base in Wan (宛; or Wancheng, present-day Wancheng District, Nanyang, Henan) and he captured over 3,000 civilians. Zhang Xiu surrendered to Cao Cao initially, but rebelled later and launched a surprise attack, which led to the Battle of Wancheng.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: However, as they were withdrawing, _____ attacked again and Cao Cao's men were unable to drive the enemy away
Cao Ren.fact: The following year, Cao Ren followed Cao Cao on a campaign against the warlord Zhang Xiu, and was authorised to lead a separate force to raid the counties around Zhang Xiu's base in Wan (宛; or Wancheng, present-day Wancheng District, Nanyang, Henan) and he captured over 3,000 civilians. Zhang Xiu surrendered to Cao Cao initially, but rebelled later and launched a surprise attack, which led to the Battle of Wancheng.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: Yuan Shao attempted to cut off Cao Cao's route to the west by sending _____ (韓猛) southwest
Cao Ren.fact: Yuan Shao attempted to cut off Cao Cao's route to the west by sending Han Meng (韓猛) southwest. Cao Ren responded to the threat by defeating Han Meng at Jiluo Hill (雞洛山; located 50 li northeast of present-day Xinmi, Henan).

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: During one battle near _____ (壺關; present-day Huguan County, Shanxi), Cao Cao gave orders that all the enemy troops would be buried alive after the city fell
Cao Ren.fact: During one battle near Hu Pass (壺關; present-day Huguan County, Shanxi), Cao Cao gave orders that all the enemy troops would be buried alive after the city fell.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: However, unlike what everyone thought, _____ managed to create havoc around the Wu's army with just 100 men left by then
Cao Ren.fact: Cao Ren was aware that his army's morale was low, since they were recently defeated at Red Cliffs, so he ordered his subordinate Niu Jin to lead 300 volunteer soldiers into battle, in the hope that they would display bravery and boost his men's morale. Niu Jin and his men were heavily outnumbered and surrounded by the enemy.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: Cao Ren () (_____ – 6 May 223), courtesy name Zixiao, was a military general serving during the late Eastern Han dynasty of China under the warlord Cao Cao, who was also his older second cousin
Cao Ren.fact: Cao Ren () (168 – 6 May 223), courtesy name Zixiao, was a military general serving during the late Eastern Han dynasty of China under the warlord Cao Cao, who was also his older second cousin.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: In the autumn of 219, _____'s general Guan Yu, who was in charge of Liu's territories in southern Jing Province, led an army north to attack Fan
Cao Ren.fact: In the autumn of 219, Liu Bei's general Guan Yu, who was in charge of Liu's territories in southern Jing Province, led an army north to attack Fan.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: Cao Cao sent the general _____ to lead seven armies to resist Guan Yu, but the armies were destroyed in a flood when the Han River overflowed due to heavy rains
Cao Ren.fact: Cao Cao sent the general Yu Jin to lead seven armies to resist Guan Yu, but the armies were destroyed in a flood when the Han River overflowed due to heavy rains. Yu Jin surrendered to Guan Yu while his subordinate Pang De refused and was executed by Guan.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: Yu Jin surrendered to _____ while his subordinate Pang De refused and was executed by Guan
Cao Ren.fact: In the autumn of 219, Liu Bei's general Guan Yu, who was in charge of Liu's territories in southern Jing Province, led an army north to attack Fan. Cao Cao sent the general Yu Jin to lead seven armies to resist Guan Yu, but the armies were destroyed in a flood when the Han River overflowed due to heavy rains.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: By the time reinforcements led by _____ arrived, the water level had subsided slightly
Cao Ren.fact: By the time reinforcements led by Xu Huang arrived, the water level had subsided slightly. While Xu Huang was attacking Guan Yu, Cao Ren seized the opportunity to counterattack and break the siege.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: He also received the title "_____ of Chen" (陳侯) and was given 2,000 more taxable households in his marquisate, making it a total of 3,500 households
Cao Ren.fact: He also received the title "Marquis of Chen" (陳侯) and was given 2,000 more taxable households in his marquisate, making it a total of 3,500 households.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: He was posthumously granted the title "_____" (忠侯), which literally means "loyal marquis"
Cao Ren.fact: He was posthumously granted the title "Marquis Zhong" (忠侯), which literally means "loyal marquis".

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: He was best remembered for his bravery and courage, which placed him above _____ among all of Cao Cao's generals
Cao Ren.fact: He was best remembered for his bravery and courage, which placed him above Zhang Liao among all of Cao Cao's generals.

Cao Ren.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Ren.question: Cao Tai was succeeded by his son _____ (曹初)
Cao Ren.fact: Cao Ren's younger brother Cao Chun was also a general under Cao Cao. Cao Tai was succeeded by his son Cao Chu (曹初).

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: The _____ was Emperor of Cao Wei from 226 to 239.
Cao Rui.fact: Cao Rui () (204 or 205 – 22 January 239), courtesy name Yuanzhong, was the second emperor of the state of Cao Wei during the Three Kingdoms period. Based on conflicting accounts of his age, Pei Songzhi calculated that, in order to be Cao Pi's son, Cao Rui could not have been 36 (by East Asian age reckoning) when he died as recorded, so the recorded age was in error; late-Qing scholars Lu Bi (卢弼) and Mao Guangsheng (冒广生) argued instead that Cao Rui was Yuan Xi's son.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: His parentage is in dispute: his mother, _____, was Yuan Xi's wife, but she later remarried Cao Pi, the first ruler of Wei
Cao Rui.fact: His parentage is in dispute: his mother, Lady Zhen, was Yuan Xi's wife, but she later remarried Cao Pi, the first ruler of Wei.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: He devoted many resources into building palaces and ancestral temples, and his reign saw the stalemate between his empire, _____, and Eastern Wu become more entrenched
Cao Rui.fact: He devoted many resources into building palaces and ancestral temples, and his reign saw the stalemate between his empire, Shu Han, and Eastern Wu become more entrenched.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: He passed the throne to his adopted son _____ and entrusted him to the regency of Cao Shuang and Sima Yi
Cao Rui.fact: He passed the throne to his adopted son Cao Fang and entrusted him to the regency of Cao Shuang and Sima Yi.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: Sima Yi became in control of the Wei government from _____ 249, eventually allowing his grandson Sima Yan to usurp the throne in February 266
Cao Rui.fact: Sima Yi became in control of the Wei government from February 249, eventually allowing his grandson Sima Yan to usurp the throne in February 266.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: His father _____ was Cao Cao's oldest surviving son and the heir apparent
Cao Rui.fact: His father Cao Pi was Cao Cao's oldest surviving son and the heir apparent. His mother Lady Zhen had been the wife of Yuan Shao's son Yuan Xi, but when she was seized by Cao Cao's army in c.mid-September 204, Cao Pi forced her to marry him, and she gave birth to Cao Rui only eight months after the wedding—leading to theories that Cao Rui was actually biologically Yuan Xi's son and not Cao Pi's.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: Lady Zhen was not allowed to accompany him to the new capital _____; in August 221, he forced her to commit suicide
Cao Rui.fact: Lady Zhen was not allowed to accompany him to the new capital Luoyang; in August 221, he forced her to commit suicide.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: Sometime during his years as the Prince of _____, he married a daughter of an aristocrat, Lady Yu, as his wife and princess
Cao Rui.fact: Because of what happened to Lady Zhen and Cao Rui's unclear origin, even though Cao Rui was the oldest of Cao Pi's sons, he was not created crown prince early in his father's reign, but was only created the Prince of Pingyuan in March 222. Sometime during his years as the Prince of Pingyuan, he married a daughter of an aristocrat, Lady Yu, as his wife and princess.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: He apparently had a cordial relationship with _____, who was created empress (in October 222); as she was sonless, his status as heir apparent was not seriously challenged
Cao Rui.fact: He apparently had a cordial relationship with Lady Guo, who was created empress (in October 222); as she was sonless, his status as heir apparent was not seriously challenged.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: His father had appointed three regents for him—his distant cousin _____, the steady administrator Chen Qun, and the shrewd strategist Sima Yi
Cao Rui.fact: His father had appointed three regents for him—his distant cousin Cao Zhen, the steady administrator Chen Qun, and the shrewd strategist Sima Yi.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: Ultimately, Zhuge's campaigns were futile; after his death in 234, his plan was largely abandoned by his successors _____ and Fei Yi
Cao Rui.fact: Ultimately, Zhuge's campaigns were futile; after his death in 234, his plan was largely abandoned by his successors Jiang Wan and Fei Yi.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: However, that did not mean that there was peace on the borders with _____, as nearly every year, there would be battles between the two states
Cao Rui.fact: However, that did not mean that there was peace on the borders with Shu Han, as nearly every year, there would be battles between the two states.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: He also entrusted the southeastern border to the capable _____, and Man's stewardship averted many disasters
Cao Rui.fact: He also entrusted the southeastern border to the capable Man Chong, and Man's stewardship averted many disasters.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: Cao Rui () (_____ or 205 – 22 January 239), courtesy name Yuanzhong, was the second emperor of the state of Cao Wei during the Three Kingdoms period
Cao Rui.fact: Cao Rui () (204 or 205 – 22 January 239), courtesy name Yuanzhong, was the second emperor of the state of Cao Wei during the Three Kingdoms period.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: Because of what happened to Lady Zhen and Cao Rui's unclear origin, even though Cao Rui was the oldest of Cao Pi's sons, he was not created crown prince early in his father's reign, but was only creat
Cao Rui.fact: Because of what happened to Lady Zhen and Cao Rui's unclear origin, even though Cao Rui was the oldest of Cao Pi's sons, he was not created crown prince early in his father's reign, but was only created the Prince of Pingyuan in March 222. He apparently had a cordial relationship with Lady Guo, who was created empress (in October 222); as she was sonless, his status as heir apparent was not seriously challenged.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: The very first came only two months after Cao Rui had become emperor in June _____
Cao Rui.fact: The very first came only two months after Cao Rui had become emperor in June 226.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: After the incident, although Gongsun formally maintained vassalage to _____, the relationship was damaged
Cao Rui.fact: After the incident, although Gongsun formally maintained vassalage to Cao Wei, the relationship was damaged. Gongsun, apprehensive of another attack from Cao Wei, sent ambassadors to Eastern Wu to formally submit to its emperor Sun Quan.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: Gongsun, apprehensive of another attack from _____, sent ambassadors to Eastern Wu to formally submit to its emperor Sun Quan
Cao Rui.fact: After the incident, although Gongsun formally maintained vassalage to Cao Wei, the relationship was damaged. Gongsun, apprehensive of another attack from Cao Wei, sent ambassadors to Eastern Wu to formally submit to its emperor Sun Quan.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: He betrayed _____, slaughtered Sun's ambassadors as they arrived in Liaodong, and seized their troops
Cao Rui.fact: Gongsun, apprehensive of another attack from Cao Wei, sent ambassadors to Eastern Wu to formally submit to its emperor Sun Quan. He betrayed Eastern Wu, slaughtered Sun's ambassadors as they arrived in Liaodong, and seized their troops.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: He commissioned _____ to prepare for an attack, and then ordered Gongsun to come to Luoyang for an official visit
Cao Rui.fact: He commissioned Guanqiu Jian to prepare for an attack, and then ordered Gongsun to come to Luoyang for an official visit.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: Gongsun then declared himself the Prince of Yan and entered into alliances with the Xianbei tribes to harass _____'s borders
Cao Rui.fact: Gongsun then declared himself the Prince of Yan and entered into alliances with the Xianbei tribes to harass Cao Wei's borders.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: Upon hearing this, _____ again requested aid from Eastern Wu
Cao Rui.fact: Gongsun then declared himself the Prince of Yan and entered into alliances with the Xianbei tribes to harass Cao Wei's borders. Upon hearing this, Gongsun again requested aid from Eastern Wu.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: Sun, angry at _____'s previous betrayal, pretended to agree, but did not send Gongsun any actual help
Cao Rui.fact: Gongsun then declared himself the Prince of Yan and entered into alliances with the Xianbei tribes to harass Cao Wei's borders. Upon hearing this, Gongsun again requested aid from Eastern Wu.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: After nearly three months of siege, _____ fell, and Gongsun fled, but was captured and executed by Sima
Cao Rui.fact: Although Sima's expeditionary force was also initially halted by torrential rains as Guanqiu's was, Sima waited out the rains and eventually surrounded Gongsun's capital of Xiangping (襄平, in modern Liaoyang, Liaoning), starving Gongsun's troops. After nearly three months of siege, Xiangping fell, and Gongsun fled, but was captured and executed by Sima.

Cao Rui.subject: Indian Languages
Cao Rui.question: Liaodong became part of _____'s domain
Cao Rui.fact: Liaodong became part of Cao Wei's domain.

Constitution of the Republic of China.subject: Indian Languages

Constitution of the Republic of China.question: Given the semi-presidential mode of constitutional governance, the _____ is the head of government while the President of the Republic is the head of state
Constitution of the Republic of China.fact: The Premier may be removed by a vote of no-confidence by a majority of the Legislative Yuan, after which the President may either remove the Premier or dissolve the Legislative Yuan and initiate a new election for legislators. Given the semi-presidential mode of constitutional governance, the Premier is the head of government while the President of the Republic is the head of state.

Constitution of the Republic of China.subject: Indian Languages
Constitution of the Republic of China.subSubject: Constitution of the Republic of China
Constitution of the Republic of China.question: Under Article 56, these cabinet members are appointed by the _____ upon the recommendation of the Premier
Constitution of the Republic of China.fact: Given the semi-presidential mode of constitutional governance, the Premier is the head of government while the President of the Republic is the head of state. Although the Premier is held accountable to the Legislative Yuan—a common feature of parliamentary systems—the presidential expansion of power has altered checks and balances between the branches of government; functionally, the Premier has become subordinate to the President.

Constitution of the Republic of China.subject: Indian Languages
Constitution of the Republic of China.subSubject: Constitution of the Republic of China
Constitution of the Republic of China.question: The _____ serves as the primary policy-making body of the executive branch, convening over administrative matters in weekly Cabinet meetings
Constitution of the Republic of China.fact: The Executive Yuan Council, called "the cabinet" (內閣; Nèigé), is composed of a Premier, a Vice Premier, a certain number of Ministers and Chairmen of Commissions, and a certain number of Ministers without Portfolio (MWPs). Under Article 56, these cabinet members are appointed by the President upon the recommendation of the Premier.

Constitution of the Republic of China.subject: Indian Languages
Constitution of the Republic of China.subSubject: Constitution of the Republic of China
Constitution of the Republic of China.question: The Cabinet conducts decision-making through a single majority vote, which may be vetoed by the _____
Constitution of the Republic of China.fact: Under Article 56, these cabinet members are appointed by the President upon the recommendation of the Premier. The Cabinet conducts decision-making through a single majority vote, which may be vetoed by the Premier.

Constitution of the Republic of China.question: Like parliaments in other countries, the _____ passes legislation, which is later sent to the President for signing
Constitution of the Republic of China.fact: Article 58 authorizes the Cabinet to assess statutory or budgetary bills concerning martial law or amnesty, declaration of war, conclusion of peace or treaties, and other affairs; the Cabinet subsequently submit bills to the Legislative Yuan. Like parliaments in other countries, the Legislative Yuan passes legislation, which is later sent to the President for signing.

Cuban peso.fact: In 1905, the National Bank of Cuba (Banco Nacional de Cuba) issued notes for 1, 2, 5 and 50 pesos. Cuban peso.question: The _____ bank notes were demonetized on May 1, 2002
